Barbell Bench Press.setup: Lie flat with your eyes under the bar. Pull your shoulder blades back and down, keep a slight arch, and plant your feet. Grip just wider than shoulder width.
Barbell Bench Press.perform: Unrack and hold the bar over your shoulders. Lower it under control to your mid/lower chest with elbows at about 45–70° from your torso. Press back up and slightly back over your shoulders.
Barbell Bench Press.avoid: Bouncing the bar off your chest, flaring your elbows to 90°, lifting your hips off the bench.

Incline Dumbbell Press.setup: Set the bench to 30–45°. Kick the dumbbells up off your knees. Keep your shoulder blades pinched and your chest up.
Incline Dumbbell Press.perform: Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your upper chest, forearms vertical, with a deep stretch. Press up and slightly together, stopping just short of the dumbbells touching.
Incline Dumbbell Press.avoid: Setting the bench too steep (the load shifts to your shoulders), losing shoulder-blade position at the top.

Machine Flyes.setup: Set the seat so the handles line up with mid-chest. Keep a slight, fixed bend in your elbows. Sit tall with your shoulders back.
Machine Flyes.perform: Bring the handles together in a wide arc and squeeze your chest hard for a moment when they meet. Return slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Machine Flyes.avoid: Pressing with your arms (elbows bending and straightening), shoulders rolling forward, letting the weight stack slam.

Dips.setup: Grip the parallel bars and lock out at the top. Lean your torso forward about 30° and bend your knees slightly behind you.
Dips.perform: Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor and you feel a chest stretch. Hold 2 s at the bottom (per your plan). Press back up, keeping the forward lean.
Dips.avoid: Staying bolt upright (it turns into a triceps dip), dropping too deep with pain at the front of the shoulder, swinging your legs.

Svend Press.setup: Stand tall holding one or two plates pressed together between your palms at chest height.
Svend Press.perform: Keep squeezing the plates together as hard as you can while you press them straight out until your arms are extended. Bring them back to your chest under control, still squeezing.
Svend Press.avoid: Easing off the squeeze, which is where the chest work comes from. Also avoid shrugging or leaning back.

Barbell Curl.setup: Stand tall with a shoulder-width underhand grip on a straight or EZ bar. Pin your elbows to your sides and brace your core.
Barbell Curl.perform: Curl the bar up to shoulder height by bending only at the elbow. Squeeze at the top. Lower under control until your arms are fully straight.
Barbell Curl.avoid: Swinging your hips or leaning back, letting your elbows drift forward, cutting the bottom range short.

Machine Preacher Curl.setup: Set the seat so the backs of your upper arms lie flat on the pad and your armpits sit snugly at its top edge. Grip the handles underhand.
Machine Preacher Curl.perform: Curl up fast and hold 1 s at the top with a hard squeeze. Lower slowly to almost full extension (per your plan).
Machine Preacher Curl.avoid: Lifting your elbows off the pad, snapping into full lockout under load at the bottom.

Hammer Curl.setup: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other (neutral grip), and elbows at your sides.
Hammer Curl.perform: Curl the dumbbells up keeping the neutral grip, thumbs leading, to shoulder height. Lower slowly on every rep (per your plan). You can alternate arms or lift both together.
Hammer Curl.avoid: Rotating your wrists into a normal curl, swinging, letting your elbows travel forward.

Dumbbell Concentration Curl.setup: Sit on the end of a bench with your feet wide. Brace the back of your working upper arm against the inside of your thigh, arm hanging straight.
Dumbbell Concentration Curl.perform: Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder, turning your pinky up slightly at the top. Hold 1 s. Lower slowly to full extension (per your plan). Finish all reps, then switch arms.
Dumbbell Concentration Curl.avoid: Using your shoulder or torso to lift, letting your arm come off your thigh.

Lat Pulldown.setup: Lock your thighs under the pad. Take an overhand grip a little wider than shoulder width. Lean back slightly with your chest up.
Lat Pulldown.perform: Start by pulling your shoulder blades down, then drive your elbows down toward your hips and bring the bar to your upper chest. Let it rise slowly over 3 s (per your plan) to a full stretch overhead.
Lat Pulldown.avoid: Pulling behind your neck, leaning far back and turning it into a row, using momentum from your torso.

Barbell Bent-Over Row.setup: Overhand grip, just wider than shoulders. Hinge at the hips until your torso is 30–45° from horizontal, knees soft, back flat, core braced.
Barbell Bent-Over Row.perform: Row the bar to your lower ribs or belly, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Lower until your arms are straight while holding the hinge.
Barbell Bent-Over Row.avoid: Standing up more with each rep, rounding your lower back, jerking the weight with your hips.

T-Bar Row.setup: Straddle the bar (landmine or T-bar station) with a close neutral grip on the handle. Hinge forward with a flat back and soft knees.
T-Bar Row.perform: Pull the handle to your chest/upper abs with your elbows close to your body. Squeeze your back hard at the top. Lower until your arms are fully straight and your lats stretch.
T-Bar Row.avoid: Rounding your back, heaving with your legs and hips, shortening the stretch at the bottom.

One-Arm Dumbbell Row.setup: Put one knee and the same-side hand on a flat bench, back flat and parallel to the floor. Hold the dumbbell in the other hand, arm hanging straight.
One-Arm Dumbbell Row.perform: Row the dumbbell toward your hip, keeping your elbow close to your body. Squeeze at the top. Lower to a full stretch. Add weight every set (per your plan).
One-Arm Dumbbell Row.avoid: Twisting your torso open to lift the weight, shrugging up toward your ear, cutting the stretch short.

Seated Cable Row.setup: Sit with your feet on the platform and knees slightly bent. Hold a close-grip (V) handle and sit tall with your chest up.
Seated Cable Row.perform: Pull the handle to your lower ribs, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Return by reaching forward until your lats stretch, keeping your back neutral.
Seated Cable Row.avoid: Rocking back and forth with your torso to move the weight, rounding your lower back, shrugging.

Lying Triceps Extension.setup: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ bar with a narrow overhand grip, arms straight over your chest, then angled slightly back toward your head.
Lying Triceps Extension.perform: Bend only at the elbows and lower the bar to your forehead or just behind your head. Extend back to the start and squeeze your triceps.
Lying Triceps Extension.avoid: Elbows flaring out wide, upper arms swinging (which turns it into a pullover), dropping the bar fast toward your head.

Triceps Kickback.setup: Hinge forward with a flat back, or support yourself on a bench. Pin your upper arm parallel to the floor, close to your torso, elbow bent at 90°.
Triceps Kickback.perform: Extend your forearm back until your arm is fully straight and squeeze hard for a moment. Return slowly to 90°. Only your forearm moves.
Triceps Kickback.avoid: Your upper arm dropping or swinging, using momentum, stopping short of a full lockout.

Rope Pushdown.setup: Attach a rope to a high cable. Stand tall with a slight forward lean and your elbows tucked at your sides.
Rope Pushdown.perform: Push the rope down until your arms are straight, then pull the ends apart at the bottom and squeeze. Let it return under control until your forearms are just above parallel.
Rope Pushdown.avoid: Your elbows drifting forward or flaring, leaning your bodyweight onto the rope, shrugging your shoulders.

Overhead Dumbbell Extension.setup: Sit on a bench with back support. Hold one dumbbell with both hands under the top plate, arms straight overhead.
Overhead Dumbbell Extension.perform: Keep your upper arms close to your head and lower the dumbbell behind your head to a deep stretch. Extend back up to full lockout.
Overhead Dumbbell Extension.avoid: Elbows flaring wide, arching your lower back, cutting the stretch short (it's the main benefit of this exercise).

Barbell Squat.setup: Rest the bar on your upper traps and pull it tight into your back. Stand shoulder-width or slightly wider, toes turned out a little. Brace your core hard.
Barbell Squat.perform: Sit down and back over 3 s (per your plan), knees tracking over your toes, chest up, to at least parallel. Drive up fast through your whole foot.
Barbell Squat.avoid: Knees caving in, heels lifting, your lower back rounding at the bottom, your chest dropping forward.

Leg Press.setup: Sit with your back and hips flat against the pad. Put your feet shoulder-width, mid-platform. Release the safeties.
Leg Press.perform: Lower over 3 s until your knees reach about 90° or deeper, as long as your hips stay down. Press up over 2 s (per your plan) to just short of lockout.
Leg Press.avoid: Your hips curling off the pad at the bottom, locking your knees hard at the top, pushing through your toes.

Goblet Squat.setup: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest, elbows pointing down. Feet slightly wider than shoulders, toes out.
Goblet Squat.perform: Squat down between your knees, keeping your torso upright, until your elbows brush the inside of your knees. Stand up by driving through your mid-foot.
Goblet Squat.avoid: Leaning forward, heels coming up, knees collapsing inward.

Stiff-Leg Deadlift.setup: Stand hip-width holding a barbell at your thighs, overhand grip. Soften your knees slightly and keep them at that angle throughout.
Stiff-Leg Deadlift.perform: Push your hips back and lower the bar along your legs with a flat back until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, around mid-shin. Come up fast and squeeze your glutes and hamstrings at the top. The bar never touches the floor (per your plan).
Stiff-Leg Deadlift.avoid: Rounding your back, bending your knees into a squat, letting the bar drift away from your legs.

Leg Curl.setup: Lie face down with the pad just above your heels and your knees just off the bench edge. Hold the handles and keep your hips pressed down.
Leg Curl.perform: Curl your heels toward your glutes with force and squeeze. Lower under full control (per your plan) until your legs are almost straight.
Leg Curl.avoid: Your hips lifting off the pad, dropping the weight, cutting the range short.

Leg Extension.setup: Sit with your back against the pad, knees lined up with the machine's pivot, and the ankle pad just above your feet.
Leg Extension.perform: Extend your legs until they're straight. Hold and squeeze your quads for 2 s at the top (per your plan). Lower slowly.
Leg Extension.avoid: Kicking the weight up with momentum, your hips lifting off the seat, dropping the stack.

Hack Squat.setup: Put your back and shoulders against the pads. Feet shoulder-width, mid-platform. Release the safeties.
Hack Squat.perform: Lower slowly until your thighs are parallel to the platform or deeper. Drive up fast and squeeze your quads at the top (per your plan).
Hack Squat.avoid: Heels lifting, knees caving in, locking out hard at the top.

Walking Lunges.setup: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides, or with bodyweight only. Keep your core braced.
Walking Lunges.perform: Take a long step forward and lower until your back knee almost touches the floor, front shin close to vertical. Push through your front heel and step straight into the next lunge. Count 50 steps per set (per your plan).
Walking Lunges.avoid: Your front knee caving in, short choppy steps, your torso slumping forward.

Seated Calf Raise.setup: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform edge and the pad snug on your lower thighs. Release the lever.
Seated Calf Raise.perform: Lower your heels slowly to a deep stretch. Drive up fast onto your toes and squeeze your calves at the top (per your plan).
Seated Calf Raise.avoid: Bouncing out of the bottom, using a short range, rolling onto your outer toes.

Standing Calf Raise.setup: Stand on the edge of the platform on the balls of your feet with your shoulders under the pads. Knees straight but not locked.
Standing Calf Raise.perform: Lower your heels slowly to a full stretch. Drive up fast as high as you can and squeeze at the top (per your plan).
Standing Calf Raise.avoid: Bending your knees to help the lift, bouncing, a quick half range.

Standing Military Press.setup: Rack the bar at upper-chest height. Grip just outside shoulder width, feet hip-width. Squeeze your glutes and brace your core.
Standing Military Press.perform: Press the bar straight up, moving your head back slightly to clear it, then bring your head through once the bar passes your forehead. Lock out over your mid-foot. Lower over 3 s (per your plan) to your upper chest.
Standing Military Press.avoid: Leaning back into a standing incline press, using your legs to push it up, flaring your elbows far out in front of the bar.

Seated Dumbbell Press.setup: Set the bench upright or at about 80°. Start with the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward, elbows slightly in front of your body.
Seated Dumbbell Press.perform: Press up and slightly in until your arms are almost locked. Lower over 3 s (per your plan) until the dumbbells reach ear or shoulder level.
Seated Dumbbell Press.avoid: Arching off the backrest, clanging the dumbbells together at the top, shortening the range.

Bent-Over Rear Delt Flyes.setup: Sit on the end of a bench or stand hinged forward with your chest near parallel to the floor. Hold light dumbbells under your chest, elbows slightly bent.
Bent-Over Rear Delt Flyes.perform: Raise your arms out to the sides, leading with your elbows, until they're in line with your shoulders. Pause, then lower slowly.
Bent-Over Rear Delt Flyes.avoid: Squeezing your shoulder blades together hard (it shifts the work to your mid-back), swinging your torso up, going too heavy.

Reverse Pec Deck.setup: Sit facing the pec-deck pad with the handles set to the rear-delt position at shoulder height. Take a neutral or overhand grip, arms nearly straight.
Reverse Pec Deck.perform: Sweep your arms out and back in a wide arc until they line up with your body. Pause, then return slowly without letting the stack rest.
Reverse Pec Deck.avoid: Shrugging, pulling with bent arms like a row, snapping back fast.

Lateral Raises.setup: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, a slight forward lean, and a slight bend in your elbows.
Lateral Raises.perform: Raise your arms out to the sides, leading with your elbows, to shoulder height, with your pinky side level or slightly higher. Lower slowly. For the 20-rep sets, go lighter and keep constant tension.
Lateral Raises.avoid: Shrugging your traps up, swinging, lifting above shoulder height.

Barbell Shrugs.setup: Stand tall holding a barbell at your thighs, overhand grip, shoulder width, arms straight.
Barbell Shrugs.perform: Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears. Hold 2 s at the top every rep (per your plan). Lower to a full stretch.
Barbell Shrugs.avoid: Rolling your shoulders in circles, bending your elbows, bouncing without the hold.

Dumbbell Upright Row.setup: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Dumbbell Upright Row.perform: Raise the dumbbells along your body, leading with your elbows, until your elbows reach about shoulder height. Lower under control.
Dumbbell Upright Row.avoid: Pulling above shoulder height, which can pinch the shoulder, and swinging.

Dumbbell Shrugs.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell at each side, palms facing in, arms straight.
Dumbbell Shrugs.perform: Shrug straight up toward your ears. Hold 2 s at the top every rep (per your plan). Lower to a full stretch.
Dumbbell Shrugs.avoid: Rolling your shoulders, bending your elbows, dropping your head forward.

Dumbbell Bench Press.setup: Sit with the dumbbells on your thighs, lie back and kick them up to chest level. Pull your shoulder blades back and down and plant your feet.
Dumbbell Bench Press.perform: Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight, palms facing forward. Lower under control until your upper arms are just below parallel to the floor, with your elbows about 45–70° from your torso.
Dumbbell Bench Press.avoid: Letting the dumbbells drift wide, bouncing at the bottom, lifting your hips off the bench.

Incline Barbell Bench Press.setup: Set the bench to 30–45°. Lie back with your eyes under the bar, shoulder blades pulled back and down, feet planted. Grip just wider than shoulder width.
Incline Barbell Bench Press.perform: Unrack the bar and lower it to your upper chest with your elbows about 45–70° from your torso. Press back up over your shoulders.
Incline Barbell Bench Press.avoid: Setting the bench too steep (it turns into a shoulder press), bouncing the bar off your chest, flaring your elbows to 90°.

Decline Barbell Bench Press.setup: Hook your legs securely under the decline bench pads and lie back with your eyes under the bar. Pull your shoulder blades back and grip just wider than shoulder width. Use a spotter or safety arms.
Decline Barbell Bench Press.perform: Unrack the bar and lower it to your lower chest under control. Press it back up over your shoulders.
Decline Barbell Bench Press.avoid: Bouncing the bar off your chest, lowering it toward your neck, going too heavy without a spotter.

Decline Dumbbell Press.setup: Hook your feet under the decline bench pads and lie back with the dumbbells at your chest. Pull your shoulder blades back and down.
Decline Dumbbell Press.perform: Press the dumbbells up and slightly together until your arms are straight. Lower under control to a deep stretch across your chest.
Decline Dumbbell Press.avoid: Letting the dumbbells drift out wide, rushing the lowering, lifting your head off the bench.

Machine Chest Press.setup: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your mid-chest. Sit tall with your back against the pad and your shoulder blades pulled back.
Machine Chest Press.perform: Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight. Return slowly until you feel a light stretch across your chest.
Machine Chest Press.avoid: Shrugging your shoulders up, letting the weight stack slam down, locking your elbows hard.

Smith Machine Bench Press.setup: Place a flat bench so the bar lines up with your mid-chest. Lie back, pull your shoulder blades back, plant your feet and grip just wider than shoulder width. Set the safety stops.
Smith Machine Bench Press.perform: Unhook the bar and lower it to your mid-chest. Press it straight up and rehook it when you are finished.
Smith Machine Bench Press.avoid: Setting the bench too far forward or back, bouncing the bar off your chest, leaving the safety stops off.

High-to-Low Cable Crossover.setup: Set both pulleys high. Stand in a split stance, lean slightly forward with a soft bend in your elbows, and hold a handle in each hand.
High-to-Low Cable Crossover.perform: Sweep your hands down and together in a wide arc toward your lower abs, squeezing your chest. Return slowly with control until you feel a stretch.
High-to-Low Cable Crossover.avoid: Bending and straightening your elbows like a press, swinging your body to move the handles, overstretching behind your torso.

Low-to-High Cable Fly.setup: Set both pulleys low. Stand in a staggered stance with a slight forward lean, a handle in each hand and a soft bend in your elbows.
Low-to-High Cable Fly.perform: Sweep your hands up and together in an arc to about chin height, squeezing your upper chest. Lower slowly back to a comfortable stretch.
Low-to-High Cable Fly.avoid: Turning it into a front raise, swinging with your legs, bending your elbows more as you get tired.

Dumbbell Flyes.setup: Lie on a flat bench with the dumbbells held above your chest, palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Dumbbell Flyes.perform: Open your arms in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest, keeping the slight elbow bend fixed. Squeeze the dumbbells back together over your chest.
Dumbbell Flyes.avoid: Straightening your arms fully, lowering well below shoulder level, using so much weight that it becomes a press.

Incline Dumbbell Flyes.setup: Set the bench to about 30°. Lie back with the dumbbells held above your chest, palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Incline Dumbbell Flyes.perform: Open your arms in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your upper chest, keeping the slight elbow bend fixed. Squeeze the dumbbells back together above your chest.
Incline Dumbbell Flyes.avoid: Straightening your arms fully, lowering well below shoulder level, using so much weight that it becomes a press.

Pec Deck.setup: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height. Sit with your back flat against the pad and your upper arms roughly level with your shoulders.
Pec Deck.perform: Bring the handles together in front of your chest and squeeze. Open slowly until you feel a stretch, without letting your elbows go far behind your torso.
Pec Deck.avoid: Rounding your shoulders forward, letting the weights crash, using momentum to swing the handles.

Push-Ups.setup: Place your hands slightly wider than shoulder width. Hold your body in a straight line from head to heels, with your core and glutes tight.
Push-Ups.perform: Lower your chest to just above the floor with your elbows about 45° from your torso. Push back up to straight arms.
Push-Ups.avoid: Sagging hips, piking your hips up, flaring your elbows out wide, cutting the range short.

Weighted Push-Ups.setup: Get into a push-up position with a plate placed on your upper back by a partner, or wear a weighted vest. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Weighted Push-Ups.perform: Lower your chest to just above the floor with your elbows about 45° from your torso, then press back up to straight arms.
Weighted Push-Ups.avoid: Sagging hips, letting the plate slide, adding weight faster than you can keep a full range.

Landmine Press.setup: Wedge one end of a barbell in a landmine or into a corner. Stand facing it holding the free end at your shoulder, feet hip-width, core braced.
Landmine Press.perform: Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight, following the arc the bar allows. Lower slowly back to your shoulder.
Landmine Press.avoid: Leaning back to push it up, shrugging your shoulder to your ear, using leg drive to cheat the reps.

Machine Dip.setup: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your lower chest. Sit tall, lean slightly forward and grip the handles.
Machine Dip.perform: Press the handles down until your arms are almost straight. Return slowly until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Machine Dip.avoid: Shrugging your shoulders up, dropping deeper than your shoulders are comfortable with, letting the weight stack slam.

Pull-Ups.setup: Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width with your palms facing away. Hang with straight arms and your shoulders pulled down away from your ears.
Pull-Ups.perform: Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back until your chin clears it. Lower slowly to a full hang.
Pull-Ups.avoid: Swinging or kipping, cutting the range short, shrugging at the bottom.

Chin-Ups.setup: Grip the bar about shoulder width with your palms facing you. Hang with straight arms and your shoulders pulled down.
Chin-Ups.perform: Pull until your chin clears the bar, leading with your chest and squeezing your elbows toward your ribs. Lower slowly to a full hang.
Chin-Ups.avoid: Swinging, jumping to start the rep, stopping short of a full hang.

Assisted Pull-Up.setup: Choose the assistance weight, then kneel or stand on the pad and grip the handles slightly wider than shoulder width. Start with your arms straight.
Assisted Pull-Up.perform: Pull your chest toward the handles by driving your elbows down until your chin clears them. Lower under control to straight arms.
Assisted Pull-Up.avoid: Using so much assistance you stop working hard, bouncing off the pad at the bottom, shrugging your shoulders.

Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown.setup: Lock your thighs under the pad and take an overhand grip well outside shoulder width. Lean back slightly with your chest up.
Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown.perform: Pull your shoulder blades down first, then drive your elbows down and back and bring the bar to your upper chest. Let it rise slowly to a full stretch.
Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown.avoid: Pulling the bar behind your neck, leaning far back, jerking the bar with your torso.

Close-Grip Lat Pulldown.setup: Lock your thighs under the pad and hold a close-grip handle with your palms facing each other. Lean back slightly with your chest up.
Close-Grip Lat Pulldown.perform: Pull your shoulder blades down first, then drive your elbows down beside your ribs and bring the handle to your upper chest. Return slowly to a full stretch.
Close-Grip Lat Pulldown.avoid: Leaning back too far, letting the weight pull your shoulders up, using momentum.

Straight-Arm Pulldown.setup: Stand facing a high cable with a straight bar or rope, hands about shoulder-width. Hinge slightly at the hips and keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Straight-Arm Pulldown.perform: Sweep the bar down in an arc to your thighs, keeping your arms almost straight and squeezing your lats. Return slowly until you feel a stretch.
Straight-Arm Pulldown.avoid: Bending your elbows into a pushdown, swinging your torso, letting your shoulders round forward.

Chest-Supported Row.setup: Set an incline bench to about 30–45° and lie chest-down on it with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight.
Chest-Supported Row.perform: Row the dumbbells toward your hips, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Lower slowly to a full stretch.
Chest-Supported Row.avoid: Lifting your chest off the bench, shrugging, using momentum.

Machine Row.setup: Adjust the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height and press your chest against the pad. Sit tall and hold the handles with your arms extended.
Machine Row.perform: Pull the handles toward you by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades. Return slowly until your arms are straight.
Machine Row.avoid: Rounding your shoulders forward at the start, jerking the weight, shrugging.

Meadows Row.setup: Wedge one end of a barbell in a landmine or corner. Stand side-on to it in a staggered stance, hinge forward with a flat back and grip the end of the bar with one hand.
Meadows Row.perform: Row the bar up toward your hip, driving your elbow back and squeezing your shoulder blade. Lower slowly until your arm is straight. Finish all reps before switching sides.
Meadows Row.avoid: Rounding your lower back, rotating your torso to lift, yanking the weight.

Pendlay Row.setup: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and hinge until your torso is close to parallel to the floor with a flat back. Grip just outside your knees.
Pendlay Row.perform: Row the bar explosively from the floor to your lower chest, then lower it under control back to the floor and reset for each rep.
Pendlay Row.avoid: Rounding your back, standing up as you pull, bouncing the bar off the floor.

Inverted Row.setup: Set a bar at about waist height. Lie under it, grip just wider than shoulder width and hang with straight arms and your heels on the floor, body in a straight line.
Inverted Row.perform: Pull your chest to the bar by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades. Lower slowly to straight arms.
Inverted Row.avoid: Sagging hips, shrugging your shoulders, cutting the range short.

Single-Arm Cable Row.setup: Sit or stand facing a low cable with a single handle. Brace your core and hold the handle with your arm extended.
Single-Arm Cable Row.perform: Pull the handle to your ribs, driving your elbow back and squeezing your shoulder blade. Return slowly to a full stretch without twisting.
Single-Arm Cable Row.avoid: Twisting your torso, shrugging, letting the weight pull your shoulder forward.

Deadlift.setup: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and your feet hip-width apart. Hinge down and grip just outside your knees, chest up and back flat. Take the slack out of the bar before you pull.
Deadlift.perform: Push the floor away and stand tall, keeping the bar close to your legs, and finish by driving your hips through. Lower by hinging your hips back first, then bending your knees once the bar passes them.
Deadlift.avoid: Rounding your lower back, jerking the bar off the floor, letting the bar drift away from your body.

Rack Pull.setup: Set the bar in a rack at or just below knee height. Stand with it over your mid-foot, hinge down and grip just outside your knees with a flat back and chest up.
Rack Pull.perform: Drive your hips forward and stand tall with the bar close to your legs. Lower it under control back to the pins.
Rack Pull.avoid: Rounding your back, leaning back at the top, bouncing the bar on the pins.

Back Extension.setup: Adjust the pad so it sits just below your hips. Lock your heels in and cross your arms over your chest, with your body hanging in a straight line.
Back Extension.perform: Lower your torso by hinging at the hips, then raise it back up until your body is in a straight line. Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Back Extension.avoid: Swinging up past a straight line, rounding your back at the bottom, using momentum.

Good Morning.setup: Rest a barbell across your upper back as you would for a squat. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, chest up and core braced.
Good Morning.perform: Hinge at the hips, pushing them back until your torso is close to parallel to the floor with a flat back. Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Good Morning.avoid: Rounding your back, letting your knees bend into a squat, using more weight than you can hinge with control.

Arnold Press.setup: Sit with a dumbbell in each hand at chest height, palms facing you and elbows in front of your body.
Arnold Press.perform: Press up while rotating your palms to face forward, finishing with your arms straight overhead. Reverse the rotation as you lower the dumbbells back to your chest.
Arnold Press.avoid: Arching your lower back, using your legs, rushing the rotation.

Machine Shoulder Press.setup: Adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height. Sit with your back against the pad and your feet flat, and grip the handles.
Machine Shoulder Press.perform: Press the handles up until your arms are almost straight. Lower slowly to shoulder level.
Machine Shoulder Press.avoid: Arching your back off the pad, shrugging, locking your elbows hard.

Push Press.setup: Rack the bar on your front shoulders with a grip just outside shoulder width, elbows slightly in front of the bar, feet hip-width and core braced.
Push Press.perform: Dip a few inches by bending your knees, then drive up explosively and use that momentum to press the bar overhead to lockout. Lower it to your shoulders under control.
Push Press.avoid: Leaning back, dipping forward onto your toes, pressing before your legs have finished driving.

Cable Lateral Raise.setup: Set a low pulley and stand side-on to it, holding the handle in the hand furthest from the stack with your arm across your body. Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Cable Lateral Raise.perform: Raise your arm out to the side to about shoulder height, leading with your elbow. Lower slowly against the resistance.
Cable Lateral Raise.avoid: Swinging with your torso, shrugging, lifting your hand higher than your elbow.

Machine Lateral Raise.setup: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot. Sit tall with your arms against the pads.
Machine Lateral Raise.perform: Raise your arms out to the sides to about shoulder height, then lower slowly under control.
Machine Lateral Raise.avoid: Shrugging, using momentum, letting the weight drop at the bottom.

Front Raise.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing you, core braced.
Front Raise.perform: Raise the dumbbells straight in front of you to about shoulder height with a slight bend in your elbows. Lower slowly.
Front Raise.avoid: Swinging the weight up with your back, lifting above shoulder height, shrugging.

Face Pull.setup: Set a rope at about face height. Take it with your palms facing in, step back until your arms are straight and stand tall with your core braced.
Face Pull.perform: Pull the rope toward your face, spreading the ends apart and driving your elbows out and back. Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then return slowly.
Face Pull.avoid: Leaning back to pull, dragging the rope down toward your chest, using more weight than you can control.

Cable Rear Delt Fly.setup: Set two pulleys at shoulder height. Take each handle in the opposite hand so your arms cross in front of you, with a soft bend in your elbows.
Cable Rear Delt Fly.perform: Pull your arms apart in a wide arc until they are in line with your shoulders, squeezing your rear shoulders. Return slowly.
Cable Rear Delt Fly.avoid: Pulling your elbows far behind your torso, shrugging, using too much weight.

Cable Shrug.setup: Stand facing a low cable with a straight bar, arms hanging straight and shoulders relaxed.
Cable Shrug.perform: Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears, hold briefly, then lower slowly.
Cable Shrug.avoid: Rolling your shoulders, bending your elbows to lift, leaning back.

Farmer's Carry.setup: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand and stand tall with your shoulders back, chest up and core braced.
Farmer's Carry.perform: Walk in a straight line with controlled steps for the target steps or distance, keeping your posture tall. Set the weights down under control.
Farmer's Carry.avoid: Leaning to one side, shrugging, rushing or taking short shuffling steps.

Dumbbell Curl.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing forward and elbows tucked in.
Dumbbell Curl.perform: Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders without moving your elbows, squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to straight arms.
Dumbbell Curl.avoid: Swinging your torso, letting your elbows drift forward, dropping the weights.

Incline Dumbbell Curl.setup: Set an incline bench to about 45–60° and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight behind your torso.
Incline Dumbbell Curl.perform: Curl the dumbbells up without letting your elbows move forward, squeeze at the top, and lower slowly to a full stretch.
Incline Dumbbell Curl.avoid: Letting your elbows swing forward, lifting your shoulders off the bench, rushing the lowering.

EZ-Bar Curl.setup: Stand tall holding an EZ-bar on the angled grips with your palms up, arms straight and elbows tucked in.
EZ-Bar Curl.perform: Curl the bar to your shoulders without moving your elbows, squeeze at the top, and lower slowly to straight arms.
EZ-Bar Curl.avoid: Swinging with your back, letting your elbows drift forward, cutting the lowering short.

EZ-Bar Preacher Curl.setup: Adjust the preacher pad so your armpits rest on top of it. Hold the EZ-bar on the angled grips with your arms extended over the pad.
EZ-Bar Preacher Curl.perform: Curl the bar up toward your shoulders, squeeze, and lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
EZ-Bar Preacher Curl.avoid: Lifting your elbows off the pad, bouncing at the bottom, dropping the weight quickly.

Cable Curl.setup: Set a low pulley with a straight or EZ bar. Stand facing it with an underhand grip, arms straight and elbows by your sides.
Cable Curl.perform: Curl the bar to your shoulders without moving your elbows, squeeze, then lower slowly against the constant cable tension.
Cable Curl.avoid: Leaning back, swinging, letting your elbows drift forward.

Spider Curl.setup: Set an incline bench to about 45° and lie chest-down on it with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down.
Spider Curl.perform: Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, squeeze, and lower slowly to a full stretch.
Spider Curl.avoid: Swinging the weights, lifting your chest off the bench, dropping the lowering phase.

Bayesian Cable Curl.setup: Set a low pulley with a single handle. Face away from the stack, step forward and take the handle so your arm is behind your torso.
Bayesian Cable Curl.perform: Curl the handle up toward your shoulder, keeping your upper arm behind your body. Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to a full stretch.
Bayesian Cable Curl.avoid: Letting your elbow swing forward, leaning your torso, using momentum.

Cross-Body Hammer Curl.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your thighs.
Cross-Body Hammer Curl.perform: Curl one dumbbell diagonally across your body toward the opposite shoulder, keeping your palm facing in. Lower slowly and alternate arms.
Cross-Body Hammer Curl.avoid: Swinging your torso, letting your elbow drift, rushing the lowering.

Rope Hammer Curl.setup: Attach a rope to a low pulley. Stand facing it and hold the rope with your palms facing each other, arms straight and elbows tucked in.
Rope Hammer Curl.perform: Curl the rope up toward your shoulders, squeeze at the top, and lower slowly. Keep your elbows still by your sides.
Rope Hammer Curl.avoid: Leaning back, swinging, letting your elbows drift forward.

Reverse Curl.setup: Hold an EZ-bar or straight bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart, arms straight and elbows tucked in.
Reverse Curl.perform: Curl the bar up toward your shoulders keeping your wrists straight, squeeze at the top, and lower slowly.
Reverse Curl.avoid: Letting your wrists bend back, swinging your torso, using more weight than your forearms can control.

Zottman Curl.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward and elbows tucked in.
Zottman Curl.perform: Curl the dumbbells up with your palms facing up. At the top, rotate your palms to face down and lower slowly. Rotate back to palms up at the bottom and repeat.
Zottman Curl.avoid: Swinging your torso, rushing the lowering, dropping the weight when you rotate.

Close-Grip Bench Press.setup: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar and a grip about shoulder-width. Pull your shoulder blades back and plant your feet.
Close-Grip Bench Press.perform: Unrack the bar and lower it to your lower chest with your elbows close to your sides. Press back up to lockout.
Close-Grip Bench Press.avoid: Gripping so narrow that your wrists hurt, flaring your elbows, bouncing the bar off your chest.

Straight-Bar Pushdown.setup: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley. Stand close to it with an overhand grip at shoulder width and your elbows tucked in by your sides.
Straight-Bar Pushdown.perform: Push the bar down until your arms are straight, squeezing your triceps. Return slowly until your forearms are just past parallel to the floor.
Straight-Bar Pushdown.avoid: Letting your elbows flare or drift forward, leaning over the bar, using your body weight to push.

V-Bar Pushdown.setup: Attach a V-bar to a high pulley. Stand close to it with your palms facing each other and your elbows tucked in by your sides.
V-Bar Pushdown.perform: Push the bar down until your arms are straight, squeezing your triceps. Return slowly until your forearms are just past parallel to the floor.
V-Bar Pushdown.avoid: Letting your elbows flare or drift forward, leaning over the bar, using your body weight to push.

Single-Arm Cable Pushdown.setup: Attach a single handle to a high pulley. Stand close to it with your elbow tucked against your side and the handle at chest height.
Single-Arm Cable Pushdown.perform: Push the handle down until your arm is straight, squeeze, then return slowly. Finish all reps on one arm before switching.
Single-Arm Cable Pushdown.avoid: Letting your elbow drift away from your side, twisting your torso, leaning on the handle.

Overhead Cable Triceps Extension.setup: Attach a rope to a low or mid pulley. Face away from it, hold the rope behind your head with your elbows pointing forward, and stand in a split stance.
Overhead Cable Triceps Extension.perform: Extend your arms forward and up until they are straight, squeezing your triceps. Return slowly to a deep stretch behind your head.
Overhead Cable Triceps Extension.avoid: Letting your elbows flare out wide, arching your lower back, using your shoulders to swing the rope.

Bench Dips.setup: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands beside your hips, then slide your hips off so your arms are straight. Put your legs out in front with your heels on the floor.
Bench Dips.perform: Lower your body by bending your elbows to about 90°, keeping your back close to the bench. Press back up to straight arms.
Bench Dips.avoid: Sinking so deep that your shoulders hurt, flaring your elbows, drifting away from the bench.

Diamond Push-Ups.setup: Get into a push-up position with your hands together under your chest so your thumbs and index fingers form a diamond. Keep your body in a straight line.
Diamond Push-Ups.perform: Lower your chest toward your hands, keeping your elbows close to your ribs. Press back up to straight arms.
Diamond Push-Ups.avoid: Sagging hips, flaring your elbows, cutting the range short.

JM Press.setup: Lie on a flat bench and unrack a barbell with a grip just inside shoulder width. Hold it over your chest with straight arms.
JM Press.perform: Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your upper chest, with your elbows pointing forward, in a path between a press and a skull crusher. Extend your arms to press it back up.
JM Press.avoid: Letting your elbows flare wide, lowering the bar toward your face, using more weight than you can control.

Machine Triceps Extension.setup: Adjust the seat so your elbows line up with the machine's pivot. Sit tall with your upper arms resting on the pad and grip the handles.
Machine Triceps Extension.perform: Extend your arms until they are straight, squeezing your triceps. Return slowly to a comfortable stretch.
Machine Triceps Extension.avoid: Lifting your elbows off the pad, leaning forward to push, letting the weight slam.

Front Squat.setup: Rack the bar across your front shoulders with your elbows high and pointing forward, using a clean grip or crossed arms. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your chest up.
Front Squat.perform: Sit straight down, keeping your torso upright and your elbows high, until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor. Drive up through your whole foot.
Front Squat.avoid: Letting your elbows drop, rounding your upper back, your heels lifting, your knees caving in.

Bulgarian Split Squat.setup: Stand a long step in front of a bench and rest the top of one foot on it behind you. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, or use bodyweight only.
Bulgarian Split Squat.perform: Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor. Push through your front heel to stand. Finish all reps, then switch legs.
Bulgarian Split Squat.avoid: Standing too close to the bench, your front knee caving in, leaning far forward, pushing off your back foot.

Reverse Lunge.setup: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides, or use bodyweight only. Keep your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Reverse Lunge.perform: Step back and lower until your back knee almost touches the floor, front shin close to vertical. Push through your front heel to return. Alternate legs.
Reverse Lunge.avoid: Your front knee caving in, taking too short a step, your torso collapsing forward.

Step-Up.setup: Stand facing a bench or box at about knee height, holding dumbbells at your sides or using bodyweight only.
Step-Up.perform: Place one foot fully on the box and drive through that heel to stand tall on it. Lower slowly and step back down under control. Finish all reps on one leg before switching.
Step-Up.avoid: Pushing off your back foot, using a box so high your form breaks down, letting your knee cave in.

Smith Machine Squat.setup: Set the bar at upper-chest height and step under it so it rests across your upper back. Place your feet slightly in front of the bar, shoulder-width apart.
Smith Machine Squat.perform: Unhook the bar, then sit down and slightly back until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor. Drive up through your whole foot and rehook the bar when you finish.
Smith Machine Squat.avoid: Placing your feet directly under the bar, your heels lifting, forgetting to rehook the bar.

Sissy Squat.setup: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold a fixed support for balance. Rise onto your toes.
Sissy Squat.perform: Bend your knees forward and lean your torso back as you lower, keeping a straight line from your knees to your head. Go as deep as is comfortable, then push back up.
Sissy Squat.avoid: Bending at the hips, dropping too fast, going deeper than your knees can handle.

Pendulum Squat.setup: Step onto the platform and set your shoulders under the pads with your back against the support. Place your feet shoulder-width apart and low on the plate.
Pendulum Squat.perform: Release the safety, then bend your knees and let the arm swing you back and down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor. Drive back up.
Pendulum Squat.avoid: Your heels lifting, your knees caving in, bouncing at the bottom.

Sumo Squat.setup: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder width and your toes turned out about 30–45°. Hold one dumbbell vertically at your chest.
Sumo Squat.perform: Sit straight down between your legs, keeping your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes, until your thighs are about parallel. Drive back up.
Sumo Squat.avoid: Your knees caving in, rounding your back, letting your heels lift.

Romanian Deadlift.setup: Hold a barbell at hip height with an overhand grip and your feet hip-width apart. Soften your knees and brace your core.
Romanian Deadlift.perform: Push your hips back, sliding the bar down your thighs with a flat back, until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings, usually around mid-shin. Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Romanian Deadlift.avoid: Rounding your back, bending your knees into a squat, letting the bar drift away from your legs.

Lying Leg Curl.setup: Lie face down with the pad just above your heels and your knees just off the bench edge. Hold the handles and keep your hips pressed down.
Lying Leg Curl.perform: Curl your heels toward your glutes and squeeze. Lower slowly until your legs are almost straight.
Lying Leg Curl.avoid: Lifting your hips off the pad, using momentum, letting the weight drop.

Seated Leg Curl.setup: Adjust the back pad so your knees line up with the machine's pivot and the ankle pad sits just above your heels. Lock the thigh pad in and hold the handles.
Seated Leg Curl.perform: Curl your heels down and back as far as you can and squeeze. Return slowly until your legs are almost straight.
Seated Leg Curl.avoid: Lifting your hips or leaning forward, jerking the weight, cutting the range short.

Nordic Curl.setup: Kneel on a pad with your ankles anchored under a fixed bar or held by a partner. Keep your body straight from your knees to your head, with your hands ready in front of you.
Nordic Curl.perform: Lower your torso forward as slowly as you can, resisting with your hamstrings and keeping your hips extended. Catch yourself with your hands, then push back up and use your hamstrings to return as far as you can.
Nordic Curl.avoid: Bending at the hips, dropping quickly, going beyond your strength without your hands for support.

Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift.setup: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand, or one in each hand. Soften your standing knee.
Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift.perform: Hinge at your hip, sending your free leg straight back for balance and lowering the weight along your standing leg with a flat back. Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift.avoid: Rounding your back, twisting your hips open, bending your standing knee into a squat.

Glute-Ham Raise.setup: Set the machine so your ankles are locked in and the pad sits just below your hips. Cross your arms over your chest.
Glute-Ham Raise.perform: Lower your torso until it is roughly parallel to the floor, then curl your body back up by contracting your hamstrings and glutes until you are upright.
Glute-Ham Raise.avoid: Swinging with your back, over-arching at the top, coming up too fast.

Hip Thrust.setup: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell across your hips. Plant your feet flat, hip-width apart, with your knees bent.
Hip Thrust.perform: Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso is in a straight line from your shoulders to your knees, squeezing your glutes at the top. Lower under control.
Hip Thrust.avoid: Over-arching your lower back at the top, pushing through your toes, letting your ribs flare.

Barbell Glute Bridge.setup: Lie on your back with a padded barbell across your hips, knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart.
Barbell Glute Bridge.perform: Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body is in a straight line from your shoulders to your knees. Squeeze, then lower slowly.
Barbell Glute Bridge.avoid: Over-arching your lower back, pushing through your toes, your knees caving in.

Cable Kickback.setup: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley. Face the machine, hold the frame for balance and lean forward slightly with the strap on one ankle.
Cable Kickback.perform: Kick your leg straight back and up by squeezing your glute, without arching your lower back. Return slowly and finish all reps before switching legs.
Cable Kickback.avoid: Swinging your leg, arching your back, twisting your hips open.

Cable Pull-Through.setup: Set a rope on a low pulley. Face away from the machine, straddle the cable and hold the rope between your legs with your torso hinged forward.
Cable Pull-Through.perform: Drive your hips forward to stand tall, squeezing your glutes, with your arms straight. Hinge back to the start under control.
Cable Pull-Through.avoid: Squatting instead of hinging, pulling with your arms, over-extending your lower back at the top.

Hip Abduction Machine.setup: Adjust the pads so they sit on the outside of your knees. Sit tall with your back against the pad and your feet on the plates.
Hip Abduction Machine.perform: Press your knees apart against the pads, squeeze your outer glutes for a moment, then bring them back slowly with control.
Hip Abduction Machine.avoid: Swinging the weight, leaning forward to cheat, letting the pads snap back.

Sumo Deadlift.setup: Stand with a wide stance and your toes turned out, the bar over your mid-foot. Grip inside your knees with a flat back and your chest up.
Sumo Deadlift.perform: Push the floor apart and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs, then lock out by driving your hips forward. Lower by hinging back first, then bending your knees.
Sumo Deadlift.avoid: Rounding your back, your knees caving in, your hips shooting up before the bar moves.

Leg Press Calf Raise.setup: Sit in a leg press and place the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform, with your legs straight but your knees not locked.
Leg Press Calf Raise.perform: Press through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can, pause, then lower slowly for a full stretch.
Leg Press Calf Raise.avoid: Bending your knees to lift, bouncing at the bottom, locking your knees hard.

Donkey Calf Raise.setup: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step and hinge at your hips, resting your torso on a pad or bench with the weight across your hips.
Donkey Calf Raise.perform: Lower your heels for a full stretch, then rise as high as you can onto your toes. Pause, then lower slowly.
Donkey Calf Raise.avoid: Bouncing, bending your knees, cutting the range short.

Single-Leg Calf Raise.setup: Stand on the edge of a step on one foot, holding something for balance. Let your heel hang below the step.
Single-Leg Calf Raise.perform: Lower your heel for a full stretch, then rise as high as you can onto your toes. Pause, lower slowly, and finish all reps before switching legs.
Single-Leg Calf Raise.avoid: Bouncing at the bottom, bending your knee, rolling onto the outside of your foot.

Crunch.setup: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat. Place your hands beside your head or across your chest.
Crunch.perform: Curl your shoulders off the floor by contracting your abs, exhaling as you rise. Lower slowly without letting your head drop back.
Crunch.avoid: Pulling on your neck, sitting all the way up, using momentum.

Cable Crunch.setup: Kneel facing a high pulley with a rope, holding it beside your head. Sit your hips back over your heels.
Cable Crunch.perform: Curl your ribs toward your hips by contracting your abs, keeping your hips still. Return slowly to the start.
Cable Crunch.avoid: Pulling with your arms, rocking your hips back and forth, hinging at the hips instead of curling.

Machine Crunch.setup: Adjust the seat and pad so the machine pivots at your waist. Sit tall and hold the handles or the pad.
Machine Crunch.perform: Curl forward by contracting your abs, bringing your ribs toward your hips. Return slowly under control.
Machine Crunch.avoid: Pulling with your arms, pushing with your hips, letting the weight stack slam.

Hanging Leg Raise.setup: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, arms straight and shoulders pulled down away from your ears.
Hanging Leg Raise.perform: Raise your legs together until they are level with your hips or higher, curling your pelvis up at the top. Lower slowly without swinging.
Hanging Leg Raise.avoid: Swinging, using momentum, letting your shoulders shrug up to your ears.

Hanging Knee Raise.setup: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, arms straight, shoulders down and core braced.
Hanging Knee Raise.perform: Raise your knees toward your chest, curling your pelvis up. Lower slowly with control.
Hanging Knee Raise.avoid: Swinging, using momentum, letting your lower back sag.

Ab Wheel Rollout.setup: Kneel on a mat holding an ab wheel under your shoulders. Round your back slightly and brace your abs.
Ab Wheel Rollout.perform: Roll the wheel forward as far as you can control, keeping your ribs tucked and your hips from sagging. Pull back to the start using your abs.
Ab Wheel Rollout.avoid: Letting your lower back sag or arch, rolling out further than you can pull back, bending at your hips.

Plank.setup: Rest on your forearms and toes with your elbows under your shoulders. Line your body up from head to heels.
Plank.perform: Hold the position with your abs and glutes tight and your ribs pulled down, breathing steadily, for the target time.
Plank.avoid: Sagging or piking your hips, letting your head drop, holding your breath.

Side Plank.setup: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder and your legs stacked. Lift your hips off the floor.
Side Plank.perform: Hold your body in a straight line from head to feet, squeezing your side abs and glutes, for the target time. Repeat on the other side.
Side Plank.avoid: Letting your hips sag, rolling forward or back, shrugging into your shoulder.

Russian Twist.setup: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and lean back to about 45°. Hold your hands together, or a weight, at your chest. Lift your feet slightly if you can.
Russian Twist.perform: Rotate your torso to one side, then the other, moving your hands across your body while keeping your chest up.
Russian Twist.avoid: Rounding your back, moving only your arms, going too fast.

Decline Sit-Up.setup: Lock your feet under the pads of a decline bench and lie back with your hands across your chest or beside your head.
Decline Sit-Up.perform: Curl your torso up toward your knees, leading with your chest, then lower slowly back down without dropping.
Decline Sit-Up.avoid: Pulling on your neck, jerking up with your arms, dropping quickly.

Pallof Press.setup: Set a cable at chest height. Stand side-on to the stack with the handle held at your chest, feet shoulder-width apart and knees soft.
Pallof Press.perform: Press the handle straight out until your arms are extended, resisting the cable's pull to rotate you. Hold briefly, then bring it back to your chest. Finish all reps, then switch sides.
Pallof Press.avoid: Letting the cable twist your torso, leaning away from the stack, shrugging.

Kettlebell Swing.setup: Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder width and a kettlebell on the floor in front of you. Hinge, grab it with both hands and hike it back between your legs.
Kettlebell Swing.perform: Drive your hips forward explosively to swing the bell to about chest height with straight arms. Let it fall and hinge back as it swings between your legs.
Kettlebell Swing.avoid: Squatting instead of hinging, lifting the bell with your arms, rounding your lower back.
